findings.title: Add complete type hints to the generation helper
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-12 says: “Python functions must carry type hints on parameters and return values”. The new helper leaves `generate_fn` untyped and has no return annotation, so its async contract is not represented in the code. Verification: `nl -ba src-tauri/sidecar/server.py | sed -n '242,247p'` shows the incomplete signature.

findings.title: [P1] Move conversion orchestration out of the sidecar route module
findings.description: This addition puts the file at 1,087 lines, up from 685, and adds a roughly 200-line model loading and audio conversion workflow directly to the general HTTP server module. That crosses the review's 1,000-line regression threshold and makes route registration, model lifecycle, and signal processing harder to change independently. Move the conversion implementation into a focused sidecar module and leave this route to validate the request and queue the work.

findings.title: Voice conversion model workflow lives in the HTTP server
findings.description: The new route's nested worker owns CosyVoice model loading, profile sample preparation, chunking, inference, and audio assembly in server.py. That makes the API layer responsible for a second speech engine and bypasses the existing speech-engine boundary in tts.py, so model changes and engine-level testing now require changing the HTTP server and its generation lifecycle together. Move the conversion workflow into a dedicated engine module (or the existing speech engine module) and keep the route responsible for request validation and queueing.

findings.title: Traversal test accepts an internal server error
findings.description: This assertion treats HTTP 500 as successful rejection, so an unhandled exception in the profile deletion path passes the security regression test. That hides broken error handling and makes the test unable to distinguish deliberate path rejection from a server crash; assert only the route's documented client-error rejection statuses and the error response.

findings.title: Voice conversion has no successful endpoint test
findings.description: All coverage for the new /voice-convert route stops at malformed requests or a missing input file. Nothing verifies that a valid profile and source are accepted, that the queued conversion reaches a terminal status, or that audio can be downloaded. The route's core behavior can therefore break while these integration tests remain green; stub the model boundary and exercise the successful request and generation lifecycle.

findings.title: [P3] Remove team and future-work notes from test comments
findings.description: These comments record temporary team coordination and speculate about a future filter. That context will age independently of the assertions and can mislead maintainers about intended behavior. Keep the test names and assertions as the contract, and remove the iteration-bound notes.

findings.title: Add a test for duration probing
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-16 says: “Every new public function, command, or component with logic must have a test in the same change”. `probe_duration` is a new public function with ffprobe and ffmpeg fallback behavior, but the changed ffmpeg tests cover only `parse_ffmpeg_time`; none exercises this function or either probe path. Verification: `rg -n 'probe_duration|fn .*duration' src-tauri/src/ffmpeg.rs src-tauri/src` returns the function and its caller, with no test for `probe_duration`.

findings.title: CWE-532: Transcription text is written to application logs
findings.description: A successful transcription response contains the user's recognized speech, and this new info log records its first 500 characters. That can persist or be exposed wherever application logs are collected, leaking private dictated content. Log only non-sensitive metadata such as response size and segment count, or redact the transcript before logging.

findings.title: Voice conversion skips padding when the video outlasts its audio
findings.description: For a recording whose video is longer than its audio track, this branch drops the probed `video_duration` that the TTS branch passes through. `voice_convert` therefore submits no `original_duration`, so `/voice-convert` defaults it to 0 and skips the sidecar's pad/truncate step; the muxed output can end with a silent audio tail instead of matching the full recording duration. Pass the probed duration through the VC request as well.

findings.title: [P2] Type the local mode as its two supported values
findings.description: The new setting only supports `tts` and `vc` (also represented by `LocalTtsMode` in Rust), but this TypeScript contract accepts any string. A misspelled mode can pass type checking at the settings call sites and drift from the Rust enum. Narrow this field to `'tts' | 'vc'` so invalid modes are rejected where they are assigned.

findings.title: Nested Uint8Array is not serialized as a Vec<u8>
findings.description: This value is passed inside the `args` object to `tauriInvoke`, whose wrapper forwards object arguments to Tauri's JSON IPC serializer. Nested typed arrays serialize as indexed objects rather than numeric arrays, while `sidecar_upload` expects `file_bytes: Vec<u8>`, so sample uploads fail during command deserialization. The same change is made for transcription uploads in `create-voice/+page.svelte`, breaking that path too. Convert the typed array to a number array, or send it through Tauri's raw-payload form with a matching `Request` command.
